University District Permit Parking
Permit Zone: UDB & UDC

Eligibility:
▪ Single-family homes and multifamily developments with four (4) units or less are eligible for one
(1) annual permit per licensed driver not to exceed six (6) permits per address.
▪ Multifamily developments built prior to December 31, 2008 with five (5) or more units are eligible
for one (1) annual permit per licensed driver not to exceed six (6) permits per address.
▪ Multifamily developments built after December 31, 2008 with five (5) or more units are not
eligible for permits unless each unit is individually addressed and has a private entrance from
the street or sidewalk.
▪ Visit www.parkcolumbus.com to view the permit parking eligibility map.

Eligibility: Institutions are encouraged to contact Parking Services at
parkingservices@columbus.gov to learn more about permit options and to set up an account to
obtain permits. Institutional uses may receive up to fifty (50) permits that are valid in the Parking
Permit zone the institution is located.

2. Current signed building lease indicating the institution as the primary lease holder or proof of

3. Valid government issues photo ID of the applicant; and
4. A letter, on organization letterhead, indicating the institution's parking need that supports the
number of permits requested.
